name: possiblaw-plugins
description: PossibLaw plugin marketplace: a two-tier progressive harness for non-developer legal builders, plus a legal-app design grill.

plugins.name: possiblaw-starter
plugins.description: Two-tier progressive harness for non-developer legal builders. Tier 1 (Starter): PLAN/TEST/REVIEW/HANDOFF pipeline, single-file continuity, runtime guardrails, simplicity ladder, and token discipline. Tier 2 (Scale): Graphify indexing and deeper review, gated by /possiblaw-starter:scale as the codebase grows. Cross-tool via AGENTS.md (Claude + Codex/AGENTS-aware tools); macOS + Linux.

plugins.name: possiblaw-vibe
plugins.description: Legal-app design grill in the spirit of Matt Pocock's grill-me skill. Walks document systems, software systems, workflows, data model, and integrations through relentless interrogation until the spec is real.
